summary: E lies in ℚ(ζ_{N₁d}); e extends to it, and g fixes its generator, hence all of it.

steps.claim: Regard ℚ(ζ_{N₁d}) as an E-algebra through toCycloField.

e extends to ψ : ℚ(ζ_{N₁d}) → ℚ̄_ℓ (algebraic extension); g∘ψ and ψ agree on the generator ζ_{N₁d} (g fixes the (N₁d)-th roots of unity, H) and hence on the whole cyclotomic field (power basis: algHom_ext); so g(e(x)) = g(ψ(x)) = ψ(x) = e(x).
steps.lean:
(surjective_domRestrict_of_isAlgebraic e.toRatAlgHom).elim fun ψ E ↦ congr($E x) ▸ congr($(((
  zeta_spec D.cycloConductor ℚ (cycloField D.cycloConductor)).powerBasis _).algHom_ext
  (f := .comp (g.restrictScalars ℚ) ψ) (by simp [H, ← map_pow, zeta_pow])) _)
